variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address of the Web App, like http://your-server-ip:6600. Change localhost to your server IP, or phones and other computers cannot use Ente. The other apps use the same address with the next ports: 6601 API, 6602 Public Albums, 6603 photo storage, 6604 mail viewer, and 6605 to 6612 for Accounts, Auth, Cast, Public Locker, Embed, Paste, Locker and Public Memories. If PUBLIC_URL is your own domain with no port, like https://photos.example.com, set ENTE_API_URL, ENTE_S3_URL and the other addresses below too, or uploads, Locker and shared links will not work.

variables.name: ENTE_API_URL
variables.description: The API address (the server address for the phone and desktop apps, and for every web app). Leave it blank to use PUBLIC_URL's host with port 6601. If you use your own domain, set it, like https://api.example.com.

variables.name: ENTE_S3_URL
variables.description: The photo storage address. Phones, browsers and the Ente server upload here, so it must be reachable from all of them. Leave it blank to use PUBLIC_URL's host with port 6603. If you use your own domain, set it, like https://s3.example.com.

variables.name: ENTE_APPS_PUBLIC_ALBUMS
variables.description: The Public Albums address for shared album links. Leave it blank to use PUBLIC_URL's host with port 6602. If you use your own domain, set it, like https://albums.example.com.

variables.name: ENTE_APPS_ACCOUNTS
variables.description: The Accounts app address (passkeys, family invites). Leave it blank to use PUBLIC_URL's host with port 6605. If you use your own domain, set it, like https://accounts.example.com.

variables.name: ENTE_APPS_CAST
variables.description: The Cast app address. Leave it blank to use PUBLIC_URL's host with port 6607. If you use your own domain, set it, like https://cast.example.com.

variables.name: ENTE_APPS_PUBLIC_LOCKER

variables.name: ENTE_APPS_EMBED_ALBUMS
variables.description: The Embed app address. Leave it blank to use PUBLIC_URL's host with port 6609. If you use your own domain, set it, like https://embed.example.com.

variables.name: ENTE_APPS_PUBLIC_PASTE

variables.name: ENTE_APPS_PUBLIC_MEMORIES
